categories.main_business_segments: Hankook & Company operates primarily as a business holding company with two main segments: the holding company segment, which generates revenue through management consulting, trademark licensing, rental income, and equity method gains from subsidiaries; and the Energy Solutions (ES) business division, focused on manufacturing and selling automotive and industrial lead-acid batteries. The ES division accounts for the majority of product sales, while the holding segment supports group companies including Hankook Tire & Technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in lead-acid battery technology, including advanced AGM (Absorbent Glass Mat) and MF (Maintenance-Free) batteries, with patented electrode manufacturing methods and vent cap designs to improve performance and safety. Production facilities utilize rotary and linear manufacturing processes enabling the production of both AGM and MF batteries on a single line. The company invests in R&D for high-performance batteries, energy storage systems, and new materials, supported by 5,101 intellectual property rights including patents and trademarks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include automotive OEMs and aftermarket sectors for vehicle batteries, as well as industrial users of batteries. The company serves domestic and international markets, with significant export sales. The holding company segment serves subsidiaries and affiliates through management consulting and licensing, while the ES division targets global automotive and industrial battery markets, including North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span South Korea, the United States, and Germany, with manufacturing plants in Daejeon and Jeonju (South Korea), Clarksville, Tennessee (USA), and a sales subsidiary in Germany. The company has a global footprint through subsidiaries and exports, with a growing presence in North America and Europe, supported by local production and sales networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hankook & Company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain. The ES business manufactures and sells finished lead-acid batteries, while the holding company manages investments, brand licensing, and consulting services. The company sources raw materials like lead and battery components from suppliers but focuses on battery assembly, branding, and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in advanced lead-acid battery technologies such as AGM, EFB, and energy storage systems, with ongoing R&D to improve durability, charging performance, and environmental compliance. Strategic focus includes expanding global sales networks, stabilizing new production facilities (e.g., US plant), and enhancing R&D capabilities to support premium branding and new energy solutions. The company also pursues business diversification through acquisitions and integration of related businesses.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of automotive and industrial batteries, trademark licensing fees from subsidiaries using the 'HANKOOK' brand, management consulting and support services to group companies, rental income, dividend income from equity investments, and equity method gains from subsidiaries. The ES business contributes the majority of product sales revenue, while the holding company segment earns from royalties, consulting, and dividends.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the domestic lead-acid battery market, Hankook & Company holds a 21.8% market share, competing with major players such as Sebang Battery (40.4%), Hyundai Sungwoo Solite (11.9%), and Clarios Delco (18.0%). The company is positioned as a leading domestic battery manufacturer with a strong presence in advanced battery segments and global expansion efforts. It also holds a leading position in the global tire industry through its key subsidiary, Hankook Tire & Technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.09 trillion KRW with a slight 0.6% decrease from the prior year, and operating profit increased by 4.6% to 256.6 billion KRW. Total assets stood at 4.64 trillion KRW, with equity of 4.02 trillion KRW and a low debt ratio of 15.5%, reflecting a solid financial structure. The ES business division accounts for about 75% of total sales, with steady production capacity and ongoing investments to support growth. The company has shown stable profitability and is investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hankook & Company emphasizes high-quality, advanced lead-acid battery products with superior durability, performance, and safety features, supported by proprietary technologies and patents. The company leverages its strong brand portfolio, including 'ATLASBX' and 'HANKOOK,' and a global production and sales network to offer reliable energy solutions. Its integrated business model combining holding company management expertise with specialized battery manufacturing enables efficient resource allocation and innovation, positioning it as a premium and trusted supplier in automotive and industrial battery markets.
